# GoSanatorium

> Free Online Sanatorium Booking platform. We help users find and book sanatoriums, health resorts, and wellness centers online.

## About
GoSanatorium is an online booking service for sanatoriums and health resorts. The platform allows users to search, compare, and book sanatorium treatments across multiple countries.
